info.name: Brushfire API: Version 2025-07-22 AccessCodes Events API
Events
Get a list of events for the specified user.

params.name: accessKey
params.description: The Access Key for the user context

params.name: search
params.description: A string to filter events

params.name: inactive
params.description: Boolean pass in true to return inactive events.

params.name: qty
params.description: An integer to limit the number of results returned

params.name: skip
params.description: An integer to skip the first events returned

params.name: archive
params.description: Boolean to return archived or not archvied events

items.docs: Get a list of events for the specified user.

info.name: Returns the best available seats that match the supplied parameters for an assigned seat event. Does not reserve them.

params.name: eventId
params.description: An integer or a GUID that corresponds to a specific event

params.name: quantity
params.description: Integer to find a quantity of seats

params.name: sectionId
params.description: An optional string (the exact name) or a GUID representing the section

params.name: accessKey
params.description: The Access Key for the user context

params.name: typeId
params.description: Optional GUID to find seats in a particular type

params.name: groupId
params.description: An optional integer or a GUID that corresponds to a specific group

params.name: seatCode
params.description: An optional seat-level access code to unlock seats

params.name: nonconsecutive
params.description: Optional boolean to find seats that are non-consecutive

params.name: basePrice
params.description: Optional decimal to find seats in a particular base price

items.docs: Returns the best available seats that match the supplied parameters for an assigned seat event. Does not reserve them.

info.name: List all currently available attendee types for a specific event and account (and optionally a specific seat)

params.name: eventId
params.description: An integer or a GUID that corresponds to a specific event

params.name: group
params.description: An integer or a GUID that corresponds to a specific group

params.name: accessKey
params.description: Access Key for user account

params.name: access
params.description: The Access Code for accessing the types

params.name: seat
params.description: A GUID that corresponds to a specific seat, if blank, will return all types for the event

params.name: category
params.description: A string value of "All", "Standard", or "Addon" which determines which type of Attendee Type will be returned. The default is "Standard" which returns only Standard types.

params.name: exchangeId
params.description: An optional exchange ID if currently exchanging
